_comment: Engine tests that fail in the committed dist/wickengine.js and always have. tests/run.mjs
exits non-zero only on a failure that is NOT listed here, so the other 540 cases can act
as a gate instead of the whole suite being permanently red. Match is on title alone, so a
listed test that starts failing a NEW way is still allowed through — the cost of keeping
the list stable while assertion messages drift. Run with --strict to ignore the list.
A listed test that passes is reported as STALE (not fatal) unless intermittent is set.

allowedFailures.title: Wick.Clip #tick unload script should run if clip stops being visible
allowedFailures.why: unload never runs; also trips checkLeaks on tempHolder, so this title fails twice

allowedFailures.title: Wick.Clip #tick unload script should run if clip stops being visible (nested clip)
allowedFailures.why: same unload bug one level down

allowedFailures.title: Wick.Project #play should send error through callback if there is an error
Wick.View.Project #render (svg) should create layers correctly for populated project
allowedFailures.why: SVG layer naming: gets wick_project_outer where wick_project_bg is expected

allowedFailures.title: Wick.View.Project #render (svg) should create layers correctly for focused clip
Wick.View.Project #render (svg) should focus background layer if there is no active frame
allowedFailures.why: off-by-one on the focused layer index

allowedFailures.title: Wick.AutoSave getSortedAutosavedProjects should return a sorted list of project info
allowedFailures.why: blows mocha's 2000ms default under load — 5 of 7 runs on a busy box, 0 of 2 on an idle one. Listed so a loaded CI runner does not go red; a failure here on a quiet machine is real.

allowedFailures.title: Wick.Project #generateAudioTrack should return an audio track with a single 1 second sound
allowedFailures.why: asserts a 48000Hz AudioContext. Passes on a box whose audio device runs at 48k, fails on a GitHub runner at 44.1k (got 44100, wanted 48000). The test hardcodes the rate; the engine returns what the context gives it.

allowedFailures.title: Wick.Project #generateAudioTrack should return an audio track with a single 0.5 second sound
Wick.Project #generateAudioTrack should return an audio track with two 0.5 second sounds
